Formulate a piece of software logic in the form of a function that yields an array composed of exactly 7 non-repeating pseudorandom numerals ranging from 1 to 20.

* Here is a function that generates an array of 7 non-repeating pseudorandom numbers from 1 to 20 using the Fisher-Yates shuffle algorithm: `function generateSevenRandomNumbers() { const numbers = Array.from({length: 20}, (_, i) => i + 1); for (let i = numbers.length - 1; i > 0; i--) { const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1)); [numbers[i], numbers[j]] = [numbers[j], numbers[i]]; } return numbers.slice(0, 7); }`
